title: Exact extension by zero is left adjoint to restriction on a ringed space
statement: Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism], let $U\subseteq X$ be an open subspace, put $\mathcal O_U=\mathcal O_X|_U$, and let $j:(U,\mathcal O_U)\hookrightarrow(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be the open inclusion. For the abelian categories of sheaves of modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], the restriction functor $j^{-1}:\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O_X)\to\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O_U)$ is exact and has an exact left adjoint $j_!:\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O_U)\to\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O_X)$ (extension by zero); thus $j_!\dashv j^{-1}$.

source.place: Cohomology, Lemma 08BS (lemma-restrict-K-injective-to-open), proof, citing Sheaves, Lemma 00A7 (sheaves-lemma-j-shriek-modules) for the adjunction j_! -| restriction and Modules, Lemma 01AK (modules-lemma-j-shriek-exact) for exactness of j_!

proof.text: Restriction to $U$ is exact. For any short exact sequence of $\mathcal O_X$-modules, restriction preserves the stalk at every point of $U$ (the neighbourhoods inside $U$ are cofinal among neighbourhoods in $X$). Thus the restricted sequence is exact at every stalk by [lem-weil-pbc-module-stalk-exact] (5), and hence exact as a sequence of $\mathcal O_U$-modules by the same criterion.

source.place: Lemma 01AG (modules-lemma-abelian), stalkwise criterion for exactness, and Lemma 01AJ (restriction to an open)

proof.text: Define $j_!\mathcal F$ as the sheafification of the presheaf that is $\mathcal F(V)$ on opens $V\subseteq U$ and zero otherwise. A map from this presheaf to an $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal G$ is equivalent, by restriction to opens in $U$, to a map $\mathcal F\to j^{-1}\mathcal G$; the inverse extends a map by zero. The universal property of module sheafification gives natural bijections $\operatorname{Hom}_X(j_!\mathcal F,\mathcal G)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_U(\mathcal F,j^{-1}\mathcal G)$, hence $j_!\dashv j^{-1}$. The underlying abelian sheaf of $j_!\mathcal F$ is the abelian sheafification of this presheaf [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification], so by [lem-sc-topological-extension-by-zero-stalks] its stalk is $\mathcal F_x$ for $x\in U$ and zero for $x\notin U$, naturally in $\mathcal F$; hence for a morphism $\varphi$ the stalk map $(j_!\varphi)_x$ is $\varphi_x$ on $U$ and zero outside. Applying [lem-weil-pbc-module-stalk-exact] (5) to these stalks shows that $j_!$ carries every short exact sequence to a short exact sequence, so it is exact; the presheaf construction is additive.
